// diagnostic

L0520

`` `{type}` has no `Display` impl — bare `{}` will require one soon ``.

What

`` `{type}` has no `Display` impl — bare `{}` will require one soon ``.

Why

Bare `{value}` interpolation is moving to the explicit `Display` hook (D-DISPLAY-SHAPE); auto-printable structs still compile via a temporary `jet_show` fallback.

Fix

add `impl {type}.Display { fn display(self) String { … } }`, or use `{value:Debug}` for debug output.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0520: tests/ui/crypto_secret_name_collisions.stderr.

Warning [L0520] (display_migration): `Secret` has no `Display` impl — bare `{}` will require one soon
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_name_collisions.jet:31:13
    |
 31 |     print("{secret}")
    |             ^^^^^^
 Why: Display is the user-facing interpolation hook; Debug is for `{value:Debug}`
 Fix: add `impl Secret.Display { fn display(self) String -> { … } }

Error [E0915]: secret-bearing `Secret` has no `Display` implementation
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_name_collisions.jet:35:13
    |
 35 |     print("{core_secret}")
    |             ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: cryptographic secrets cannot enter logs or strings through interpolation
 Fix: remove the interpolation; log a public operation label or key identifier instead
